background_notes.justification: A linear subspace contains zero and is closed under scalar multiplication and addition, so induction on a finite sum shows it contains every finite linear combination of the u_i. The set of such combinations is their linear span: it is a subspace containing the family and is contained in every subspace containing the family. Hence the span lies in Z. If it is T, both inclusions between Z and T hold.
